capability.auth: BYOK per pengguna via Connection (apiKeyEncrypted server-only, baseUrl gateway, revision FIX-05); model dipilih pengguna saat submit, dipin pada snapshot; tidak ada penggantian provider diam-diam

capability.budgetEstimation: model-budget per model: contextTokens/reserveTokens; sumber gateway → known-family → assumed (label budgetSource); cap server selalu menang terhadap limit model
capability.pin: model/provider/connection revision/system prompt hash/tool schema version/limits/estimator version dibekukan di TaskRun configJson; API key tidak pernah dipin
capability.status: tool-call compatibility provider belum diverifikasi live; model eval/provider/version pin = blocked_external sampai consent biaya + akses tersedia

limits.searchRead: ≤5 hasil/query, ≤40 hasil, ≤8 sumber unik, parallel fetch ≤2
limits.toolInvocations: ≤24 termasuk retry; ≤1 retry transient per logical call; invalid/denied tidak retry
limits.timeouts: read-only 120s absolute; search 8s; read 10s; sandbox ≤15 menit terpisah
limits.modelTokens: input kumulatif ≤24000; output ≤6000; reserve final input 4000 + output 1000 (bagian dari jatah, bukan tambahan)
limits.body: search ≤512 KiB; read ≤2 MiB decompressed; extract ≤200.000 karakter; prompt excerpt ≤6000/sumber
limits.upload: ≤10 MiB/file, ≤5 file, ≤25 MiB/run; orphan staging dibersihkan 24 jam; retensi 7 hari
limits.parser: parser 10s/256 MiB; ZIP expanded ≤50 MiB/1000 entries/100:1; JSON depth ≤50/nodes ≤100.000; XLSX ≤50 sheets/20.000 cells; CSV ≤100 kolom/20.000 cells; PDF ≤200 halaman; inspect preview 20×20, cell ≤500 karakter, total ≤8000 karakter; UI tabel 50×12 DOM (cap berbeda)
limits.sandbox: 1 CPU, 1024 MiB RAM, disk 256 MiB, command 60s/run 15 menit, stdout+stderr masing-masing 256 KiB, ≤10 output/25 MiB, network none (termasuk DNS/IPv6/metadata/proxy)
limits.lowerCapWins: cap deployment/model lebih rendah selalu menang terhadap angka manifest
